cachePreparation.inputFileCache: No input reads by harness before launches; prior trusted hashes checked after batch; OS/file/driver caches untouched and unverified

measurementClocks.launchEndpoints: Native process clock plus launch-to-main offset; frontend events use native IPC receipt time
measurementClocks.frontendSpans: Exact WebView clock bounds are retained in events when available; durations do not require a cross-clock conversion
measurementClocks.fileReadyMs: Launch-relative IPC receipt of successful file frame, not the WebView operation endpoint
